findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:177-191 and packages/main/src/core/mkdir-lock.ts:279-286 — HIGH: workspace-capacity stale recovery is not identity-conditional. acquireMkdirLock reads holder A, then classifyValidationCapacityLock re-reads heartbeat from the mutable fixed path; if A releases and live successor B acquires between those reads, the A/B mismatch is classified stale and rmSync(lockDir,{recursive:true}) deletes B. A waiter can then acquire alongside B, violating the one-official-validation invariant. Use an identity-stable unique-ticket/compare-and-delete reclaim (or revalidate the same ownership token atomically) and add an ABA successor race regression; static mismatch fixtures do not cover this interleaving.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6c85b1143c: fixed-path capacity reclaim was replaced by never-reused UUID bakery tickets with atomic exact-ticket quarantine; stale A cleanup cannot delete successor B. Covered by 20-round 12-waiter ABA stress with maxConcurrency=1.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:207-225,238-241,421-424; packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1066-1077 — the capacity key is derived from options.root even though the handler already passes the resolved signed git workspace as workspaceRoot. In a supported bare metadataRoot/configured-gitRoot layout, git -C options.root fails and resolveSharedLockRoot silently falls back to the metadata wrapper, so the lease is not keyed by the repository git-common-dir as docs/CLI.md:907 and testing-infra.md:55 promise; separate wrappers over one repository can run official validations concurrently, and a transient git-probe failure similarly splits linked-worktree locks. Separate capacityRoot/workspaceRoot from the legacy story-evidence root, fail closed on an expected-git identity resolution failure, and add a wrapper-root/common-dir regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6c85b1143c: workspace capacity identity is derived from the supplied workspaceRoot git-common-dir; official callers requireGitIdentity and fail closed in wrapper/non-git ambiguity. Linked-worktree and wrapper regressions pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:453 — stale-capacity takeover is not ownership-atomic. withWorkspaceValidationCapacity passes classifyValidationCapacityLock into acquireMkdirLock, whose stale branch classifies the observed holder and then recursively removes the shared path without atomically isolating/revalidating that exact ownership token (packages/main/src/core/mkdir-lock.ts:285-286). With multiple waiters, one waiter can reclaim the dead holder, a successor can acquire, and another waiter that already classified the old holder stale can delete the successor's live lease, breaking maxConcurrency=1. Reproduced against built HEAD with 12 worker threads and a mechanically dead seed: after 159 rounds, overlaps=1 and errors=8. Replace classify-then-rm with atomic stale-directory/token isolation before deletion and add a simultaneous multi-waiter stale-recovery regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6c85b1143c: classify-then-recursive-delete was removed from capacity acquisition; atomic rename isolates the exact UUID candidate before deletion, and failed rename remains active. Mechanical 12-waiter stress now passes with zero overlap.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:288-340,563-584,845-915,921-954,963-984 — HIGH: verificationEvidence records PASS for all 29 must intents, mostly by reusing the 5-group focused smoke, but the executable cases do not discriminate at least these required claims: CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-001:adversarial:2 never run contending validators from two linked worktrees (only same-root handlers plus lock-path equality); CHK-001:edge:1 has abort coverage but no active-owner deadline case proving neither callback nor inner story lock is entered; CHK-002:happy:1 covers only validate -> done_required_validate, not the reverse order or both evidence artifacts; CHK-002:edge:1 never kills a live child owner with a queued successor; CHK-002:edge:2 never queues three waiters or asserts maxConcurrency=1/eventual entry; CHK-002:adversarial:0 only observes lock presence during persistence without a competing story or overwrite check; CHK-002:adversarial:1 does not integrate same-story official nesting with an independent queued process; CHK-003:happy:0 never validates DONE-required evidence hash bindings; CHK-003:edge:0/edge:1/edge:2 and CHK-003:adversarial:0 have no inventory+120/180/300 snapshot, read-only-command bypass, stale-evidence replacement, or bare-npm-test bypass cases. CHK-003:adversarial:1 additionally records only `npm --prefix packages/main run build`, omitting its required protected-file `git diff --exit-code` command. Therefore these regressions can survive while the focused command and 29/29 receipts remain green. Independent review reproduced focused PASS, protected-file zero diff, and exact-58 terminal PASS; the blocker is missing discriminating evidence, not an asserted implementation defect.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6c85b1143c: expanded discriminating coverage includes linked worktrees, wrapper fail-closed identity, reverse validate/done evidence, killed owner and killed-before-publication, 12 waiters, reentrancy/sibling exclusion, deadline/abort no-inner, verdict writer capacity, bare/read-only bypass, and protected inventory/timeout zero diff. Full lock smoke passes 22 groups.

findings.desc: F-002 remains incompletely resolved for no-story validate. packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1066-1073 collapses unresolved project-level Git resolution to projectRoot, then decides requireGitIdentity only from Boolean(args.story) or the physical existence of <handlerGitCwd>/.git. In a metadata-wrapper project that explicitly configures gitRoot, an invalid or transiently failed Git probe makes resolveProjectGitCwd return the non-Git metadata root; because args.story is absent and that wrapper has no .git, requireGitIdentity becomes false. packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:249-264 then deliberately falls back to the wrapper root instead of failing closed, so this official no-story validate can mint a capacity namespace different from a live validation under the actual git-common-dir. Mechanical reproduction against current dist with an existing non-Git configured-repo printed {configuredGitRoot:"configured-repo", workspaceRoot:"<metadata-wrapper>", requireGitIdentity:false, capacityPath:"<metadata-wrapper>/.lattice/locks/validation-capacity.lock", underMetadataWrapper:true}; calling validationCapacityLockPath(wrapper,true) on the same identity rejects as intended. This contradicts docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:55 and docs/CLI.md:907, which promise that expected/configured Git identity resolution fails closed. The focused 11-group contract still passes because packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:1193-1216 calls withWorkspaceValidationCapacity directly with requireGitIdentity:true; it never drives the no-story verifier handler through a configured-gitRoot resolution failure. Preserve the genuine non-Git fallback, but derive expected-Git from the configured workspace contract/resolution result (not only args.story or .git existence) and add a handler-level wrapper regression proving callback non-entry on unresolved configured Git identity.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6fcfb1c599: no-story validate now loads config once, treats an explicit configured gitRoot as authoritative, resolves it directly, and fails before capacity acquisition or callback when unresolved. Handler-level regression proves no wrapper lock is minted.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:593 ignores the boolean returned by quarantineValidationCapacityCandidate during release. A deterministic chmod fault probe made renameSync fail after a successful callback: withWorkspaceValidationCapacity still returned callback-ok, left its numbered .ticket owned by the still-live PID, and a same-process successor hit workspace validation capacity wait deadline exceeded. This violates CHK-002:edge:0 release/eventual-success semantics and can stall every later official validation in a long-lived CLI/MCP host without any release error. Treat release isolation failure explicitly (while preserving an original callback failure) and add fault-injection coverage for failed release rename/quarantine cleanup.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6fcfb1c599: exact-ticket release uses bounded isolation retries; persistent failure is explicit after successful callback, preserves original callback errors, and marks only the owned UUID ticket mechanically reclaimable. Deterministic permission-failure regression proves repaired successor entry and no leak.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/CLI.md:907, docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:55, and docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:30 state that persistent release-isolation failure marks the exact ticket mechanically reclaimable for a successor; the plan also says that failure is reported without replacing an original callback error. packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:486-514 explicitly allows markValidationCapacityTicketReleased to fail, leaving the ticket fail-closed and requiring filesystem repair. Lines 643-650 discard releaseError when the callback already failed, so that release failure is not separately reported. Update the docs to describe both marker-success recovery and marker-failure filesystem-repair branches, and state accurately that an original callback error takes precedence rather than claiming both errors are reported.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 3aa0f14bc3 makes the operator documentation match runtime behavior: marker-success permits mechanical recovery, marker-failure remains fail-closed and requires filesystem repair, and the original callback or wait error remains primary.

findings.desc: .lattice/story/actives/B-6693/checklist.json:62 and :357 still pin the focused/full verification selectors to exact `5 assertion groups` and `16 assertion groups`, but packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:1424 and :1438 now emit exact `13 assertion groups` and `24 assertion groups`. Reproduction on HEAD f6b8ba8: build PASS; focused outputs 13; full outputs 24; exact58 PASS. Because verification_evidence_refresh_stale re-executes each immutable pin through selector matching, these current commands cannot refresh the affected stale mechanical receipts: the selector is absent and those rows are demoted. Session brief already reports all 29 must-intent evidence rows stale; 24 capacity-smoke intents have obsolete selectors. Update the intent pins/selectors in DEV and re-run/re-record current mechanical evidence before coverage can pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 2bd3249f5a added the managed strict verification pin schema; commit 9d18e3dc78 repaired all 24 obsolete 5/16 selectors to exact 14/25; every pinned command was reexecuted at the current material and verification_evidence_refresh_stale dry-run reports no stale evidence.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:623-626 — queued waiter abort/deadline cleanup still bypasses the hardened releaseValidationCapacityTicket path: it calls quarantineValidationCapacityCandidate once and ignores false. Under the same deterministic parent-directory permission fault covered for acquired-owner release, the waiter deadline is preserved but its published UUID ticket remains. Because holder.json names the current live PID and the heartbeat identity still matches, classifyValidationCapacityLock at lines 187-201 keeps that abandoned ticket active indefinitely; after the true owner releases, a successor reaches its own deadline without entering. Reproduced on HEAD f6b8ba8b876895cdc532b096397791d4f10f1d94: two tickets were present before chmod 0555; waiter returned queued-waiter-deadline with both tickets remaining; after owner release the waiter ticket remained; successor returned successor-deadline and successorEntered=false. Route published-ticket cleanup in the acquisition catch through the same bounded ownership-safe release/mark-reclaimable mechanism while preserving the original abort/deadline error, and add a queued-waiter cancellation plus isolation-failure regression. Current smoke coverage at packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:1214-1284 exercises only post-acquisition callback release.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 3aa0f14bc3 routes abort and deadline cleanup through bounded exact-UUID ticket release, preserves the original sentinel error, leaves the active owner untouched, and proves post-repair successor entry with no ticket leak in deterministic regressions.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:35-36,87-95,577 — HIGH concurrency defect: reentrancy ownership is keyed only by lock path, not the current acquisition lockId/generation. A timer created inside owner A retains A AsyncLocalStorage after A returns; when owner B later holds the same path, heldValidationLockPaths is true again and detached A is falsely treated as B reentrancy, bypassing capacity. Current-dist deterministic repro produced {detachedEntered:true,overlap:true}. Bind global and ALS ownership to the same acquisition token and add a detached-old-context versus new-owner regression; the same path-only pattern in the inner story lock must also be audited.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit fe96056b33 binds both workspace-capacity and per-story active ownership to never-reused acquisition tokens; reentrancy requires exact ALS/current-token equality. Checked-in detached owner-A versus owner-B regressions for capacity and official capacity plus story lock prove maxConcurrency=1.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:1547-1577 — HIGH proof-count defect: the focused prefix invokes 15 distinct assertion-group functions but prints and pins 14; the full path then invokes 11 more (26 total) but prints and pins 25. Exact 14/25 selectors therefore certify a manually stale undercount, and removal of one real group could remain green without changing the pinned terminal text. Derive/verify the count mechanically or correct both terminal counts and managed selectors/evidence together.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit fe96056b33 corrects actual terminal counts to focused 15 and full 26. Managed commit c2c48c835b migrates exactly 24 pins with old14/old25 zero; all 14 focused and 10 full pinned receipts were independently reexecuted with selectorMatched=true and stale dry-run is zero.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1062-1087 and packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1079-1088 — HIGH production cleanup defect: direct validate is excluded from structuredWatchdog, so args.abortSignal/deadlineAt are undefined and watchdog timeout calls process.exit(2) instead of aborting the capacity waiter through F-009 cleanup. A real CLI probe held workspace capacity and ran validate with LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=250: it logged aborting with structured result but exited 2 with empty stdout, left two tickets while owner held and one dead waiter ticket after owner release; only a later successor reclaimed it. Include validate in structured cancellation/deadline propagation and add a real CLI contention watchdog regression asserting classified output and zero waiter ticket immediately after timeout.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit fe96056b33 includes direct validate in structured watchdog propagation while keeping done-result classification separate. Real child CLI contention regression proves classified max-timeout exit 1, callback zero, no inner story lock, waiter cleanup, and successor direct acquisition; current focused/full receipts all pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:877-910 — MEDIUM regression-quality gap: the checked-in 12-waiter ABA stress uses Promise.all in one Node event loop while all filesystem classification/rename/remove operations are synchronous, so it cannot create the parallel Worker/process interleaving that originally exposed F-003. External Worker stress has passed, but that proof is not retained by the suite and a future fixed-path classify-then-delete regression could escape. Add a checked-in worker_threads or child-process stale-reclaim stress with an overlap sentinel and exact ticket-leak assertions.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit fe96056b33 upgrades the stale/ABA stress to checked-in cross-process contenders while preserving the existing assertion group, proving 12 waiters, maxConcurrency=1, zero overlap/errors, and zero ticket leak.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/CLI.md:907, docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:55, and docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:30 describe direct validate structured watchdog/deadline cleanup but omit the repaired terminal-classification boundary. packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1062-1125 deliberately separates structuredDoneResult (done_prepare/done_required_validate only) from structuredWatchdog (also validate), so direct validate keeps isCanonicalCommandFailure rather than inheriting DONE structured-result classification. Add that distinction so structured cancellation is not read as a change to validate stdout/exit semantics.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 61532dba5d updates all three capacity documents: direct validate uses structured watchdog only for abort/deadline propagation and waiter cleanup, while structuredDoneResult and the DONE-result classifier remain exclusive to done_prepare/done_required_validate and validate retains its existing classification/exit contract.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: the capacity documentation at docs/CLI.md:907, docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:55, and docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:30 omits the final retained proof boundary added for F-011/F-013. packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:913-994 now runs checked-in independent child-process stale-reclaim stress with maxConcurrency=1, zero overlap, and zero queue leaks; lines 1742-1774 define exact focused/full terminal contracts of 15 and 26 assertion groups. Document the cross-process regression and current exact 15/26 terminal/pin values so operator assurance does not silently rely on the weaker prior in-process-only or stale 14/25 proof.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 61532dba5d records in all three documents the checked-in exact-12 child-process stale/ABA regression, distinguishes it from the in-process cohort and runtime guarantees, and states the exact managed focused15/full26 terminal-pin contract; current docs evidence is refreshed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.ts:892-907 runs/asserts 12 waiters only as Promise calls inside one Node process. The genuinely independent child-process cohort at :958 spawns `length: 8` and at :987 asserts exactly 8 starts. Thus the checked-in focused15/full26 smoke does not prove the required exact-12 cross-process/execution-context stress; both commands pass while this requirement remains absent. Change the child cohort to 12 and assert 12 process starts, maxConcurrency=1, zero overlap, and zero leaked queue artifacts. The new detached-generation and real CLI-watchdog assertions are discriminating against the prior implementation, but they do not substitute for the missing 12-process capacity stress.
